# CHANGE ORDER PROPOSAL — CO-001

**Project:** Reporting Dashboard
**To:** Client Sponsor  |  **From:** [Vendor]  |  **Date:** [Date]

---

## 1. Background

The existing signed scope covers the reporting dashboard. The work described below is not included in the original fee.

## 2. Requested Work

Client requests an additional CRM connector. Per the governing terms, the sponsor must approve this change in writing before any connector work begins.

## 3. Price

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Estimated effort | 40 hours at $175/hour |
| Proposed fixed change fee | **$7,000** (40 × $175 = $7,000) |

The proposed fee is fixed; the connector is not covered by the original fee.

## 4. Schedule Effect

The connector adds approximately **two weeks**. That period begins only after both:

1. Written approval of this proposal by the sponsor, and
2. Receipt of client sandbox credentials.

The two-week figure is an estimate, not an approved calendar date.

## 5. Client Dependency

Client must provide sandbox credentials. The connector schedule cannot start until they are received alongside written approval.

## 6. Decision Requested

Please approve or decline this change order:

☐ **Approved** — sign and return; the two-week estimate then applies following credential receipt.

☐ **Declined** — no connector work will be performed; scope remains as originally signed.

---

## Sponsor Authorization (written approval required)

Signature: ______________________________

Name / Title: ______________________________

Date: ______________________________

---

*This proposal is valid as drafted; all amounts, hours, and durations above are estimates per the stated basis and require written sponsor approval to take effect.*
